sara_support: FYI — ticket INC-4721. Customer in eu-west-1 reporting majority of requests routed to a US pop. p95 latency up ~500–800ms, intermittent 401s, and a billing alert fired. Repro attached.

anya_support: Adding logs from customer, they say `curl` to api.redwood.com resolves to 3.210.45.12 (us-east). They use FastISP EU resolver.

oliver_engnet: Can you paste a quick `dig +trace +edns-client-subnet` output and the resolver IP? Also which client ASN if available?

sara_support: Paste from customer (sanitized):
```bash
$ dig @8.8.8.8 +short api.redwood.com
3.210.45.12
$ dig @1.1.1.1 +short api.redwood.com
3.210.45.12
$ dig +trace api.redwood.com
; -> answers from us-east pool
```
They also ran from an EU VM and got the same. ISP appears to be doing a proxy/resolver aggregation.

mike_sre: Likely EDNS-Client-Subnet stripping / ISP proxying. If the resolver strips ECS we may end up with a non-local answer. Also the occasional 401 suggests token validation sometimes hitting a different auth cluster (cache miss).

oliver_engnet: Confirmed bug in fallback: if eu pool signals congestion, our fallback selection can pick a any-compatible variant in another region without preferring same-region, which explains cross-region flips mid-session.

sara_support: Customer repro steps: 1) From Frankfurt VM `curl -v https://api.redwood.com/v1/...` 2) TLS cert shows us-east leaf host 3) p95 jumps 500–800ms 4) after ~1m some requests return 401 then succeed on retry.

anya_support: Short trace from customer logs:
```text
2026-03-16T09:12:03Z request start -> routed to us-east -> auth lookup miss -> 401 -> client retries -> hits eu -> success
```

mike_sre: Auth 401s are consistent with session/token lookups missing when requests flip clusters. Mitigation: pin their account to eu pool while we fix routing. Also we should monitor auth-401 rate for correlated spikes.

oliver_engnet: Proposed fixes/mitigations:
1) Update GeoIP DB (v2026-03-15) to include known FastISP proxy ranges.
2) Change fallback ranking to prefer same-region answers even if slightly higher load.
3) Increase DNS TTL for eu-pop answers to 60s to reduce oscillation while we roll patch.
4) Honor an `X-Redwood-Prefer-Region: eu-west-1` header as an explicit pin for SDKs/clients (short-term).

sara_support: Customer agreed to temporary pin. I've applied a route override to account 45321.

deploy-bot: route-override applied to acct 45321 by sara_support at 2026-03-16T11:05:22Z :white_check_mark:

mike_sre: Action items assigned: (oliver) push GeoIP update + PR, (mike) change fallback policy, (support) confirm billing spike stops and keep customer posted, (sara) keep account pinned until patch lands.

anya_support: I'll monitor the customer's telemetry and billing alerts; will report back in 2h.

oliver_engnet: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/geoip/compare/fix-isp-proxy (link internal). Fallback policy PR is queued, ETA ~2h for review.

mike_sre: Leaving final validation to eng-network and SRE. If auth 401s persist after pin removal, escalate to #eng-sre.

oliver_engnet: Thanks — follow-up in #eng-network if we need long investigations :eyes:
